headline: TBM milestones on three continents, a Zuidasdok tunnel decision due within weeks, and Amsterdam's quay-wall programme leaning on 10-year temporary steel walls.
talkingPoint: Amsterdam keeps permitting temporary steel 'noodconstructies' along failing quay walls for 10-year periods (Amstel 114, Oudeschans). Is our design basis for 'temporary' really suited to a decade in soft soil, or are we designing permanent structures under a temporary label?
